facts.label: Root cause
facts.value: sms-otp calls Contoso SMS with no timeout from a fixed pool of 64 workers; a slow provider blocks every OTP proven

facts.label: Workaround
facts.value: feature flag sms.provider=fabrikam (switch the provider by hand)

note.text: Argus's options for this problem, from RCA #51. Production: the operator approves every option.

kv.label: Why it works
kv.value: a slow provider costs at most 3 s per message and trips the breaker after 20 failures; traffic moves to Fabrikam within a minute

kv.label: Risk
kv.value: low: the release has run on staging for 6 days

kv.label: Blast radius
kv.value: sms-otp on both payment hosts; OTP for payment and login for about 1 minute during the rolling restart

options.title: Provider timeout and automatic failover
options.what: set `SMS_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT=3s` and `SMS_FAILOVER=fabrikam` in `/etc/northwind/sms-otp.env` on `prod-pay-01` and `prod-pay-02`, deploy `payments/sms-otp` 2.14.0 (circuit breaker, already on staging)

kv.label: Why it works
kv.value: the healthy provider carries the traffic; nothing else changes

kv.label: Risk
kv.value: medium: Fabrikam costs 40 % more per message and has a 200 msg/s cap

kv.label: Blast radius
kv.value: none now; a Fabrikam outage would repeat the incident

options.title: Keep Fabrikam as primary until Contoso confirms the fix
options.what: leave the feature flag `sms.provider=fabrikam`; add a calendar reminder to switch back

kv.label: Why it works
kv.value: pages 5 minutes into a provider slowdown instead of after the backlog

options.title: Alert on provider latency and worker saturation
options.what: alert rules `SmsProviderSlow` (p99 > 2 s for 3 min) and `SmsOtpWorkersSaturated` (> 90 % for 2 min) in `monitoring/rules/payments.yml`

fix.prompt:
PRODUCTION CHANGE — needs the operator's explicit approval before any step.
# sms-otp: provider timeout and automatic failover on prod-pay-01 / prod-pay-02
## Goal
`sms-otp` gives up on a slow SMS provider after 3 s and fails over to Fabrikam Messaging automatically; OTP delivery
survives a provider slowdown.
## Environment and targets
- Environment: production
- Hosts: prod-pay-01 (10.20.30.41), prod-pay-02 (10.20.30.42)
- Unit: `northwind-sms-otp.service`, env file `/etc/northwind/sms-otp.env`, port 8091
- Repository: `payments/sms-otp`, tag `2.14.0` (circuit breaker), CI deploy job `deploy_production` (manual)
## Background
- Root cause (proven): no provider timeout; 64 workers blocked on Contoso SMS for 2 h 40 min; 2,140 payments failed.
- Evidence: `sms_otp_workers_busy` 64/64; Contoso p99 31.2 s; `SMS_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT` unset.
- Timeline (UTC): 17:41 slowdown, 20:23 manual switch to Fabrikam, 20:35 recovered.
## Constraints and guardrails
- Production is read-only unless the operator approved this exact change: show each command, its backup and its
  rollback first, then wait.
- Never write to a production database. Never run a production deploy pipeline yourself; the operator plays the job.
- One host at a time; prod-pay-02 first.
## Pre-checks (run first; stop on any failure)
1. `curl -fsS http://10.20.30.42:8091/health` → `{"status":"ok"}`.
2. `grep -c . /etc/northwind/sms-otp.env` on both hosts → the file exists.
## Change, step by step
### Step 1: env file on prod-pay-02
- Backup: `cp -a /etc/northwind/sms-otp.env /etc/northwind/sms-otp.env.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)`
- Change: append `SMS_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT=3s` and `SMS_FAILOVER=fabrikam`
- Check: `systemctl restart northwind-sms-otp && sleep 5 && curl -fsS localhost:8091/health`
- Rollback: restore the backup and restart the unit.
### Step 2: the same on prod-pay-01, then ask the operator to play `deploy_production` for 2.14.0
## Verify
- `sms_otp_provider_latency_seconds` p99 < 3 s; a test OTP to the QA phone arrives in < 10 s.
- `SmsOtpQueueBacklog` resolved; payment failure rate at the baseline.
## Prevention follow-up
- Alert rules `SmsProviderSlow` and `SmsOtpWorkersSaturated` (Option 3).
## Do not touch
- payment-gateway, fraud-check, the database.
## Report back
- What you changed (diffs), the backup paths, the verification output, anything still open.

rows.label: What broke
rows.value: Payment and login OTP SMS were not delivered for 2 h 40 min.

rows.label: Why
rows.value: Contoso SMS answered in 30 s; sms-otp has no timeout, so all 64 workers hung (proven).

rows.label: Impact
rows.value: 2,140 card payments failed at 3-D Secure; about 31 % of checkouts.

rows.label: Fix
rows.value: Provider timeout with automatic failover (Option 1) — the operator approves (production).
